findings.title: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads ATS exception enabled
findings.whyItMatters: Apple documents that a justification must be supplied during App Store review when NSAllowsArbitraryLoads is YES.
findings.suggestedAction: Use a narrower exception (NSExceptionDomains) if possible, or prepare a clear review justification.

findings.title: Permission purpose string is empty: NSMicrophoneUsageDescription
findings.whyItMatters: Apple requires a message that tells people why the app requests access; an empty or placeholder string fails that purpose.
findings.suggestedAction: Provide a clear, specific purpose string for the permission.

findings.whyItMatters: A new protected-resource permission changes the App Store review surface and the user-facing permission prompt.
findings.suggestedAction: Confirm the permission is actually used and the purpose string is clear and specific.

findings.title: Background mode introduced: audio
findings.whyItMatters: Apple limits background execution to intended purposes. A new background mode is a review-sensitive capability that should match actual app behavior.
findings.suggestedAction: Confirm the background mode is required and matches the app functionality described to reviewers.

findings.title: Review-sensitive SDK added (purchases)
findings.evidence: This PR adds "react-native-purchases" (in-app purchases or subscriptions) to package.json dependencies. App Store review/privacy/payment surfaces may have changed.
findings.whyItMatters: Purchase, advertising, tracking, analytics, social-auth, and AI/data-processing SDKs are categories App Review and privacy processes look at closely.
findings.suggestedAction: Confirm the SDK is required, and update App Privacy / review materials if the data surface changes.
